asr.full_text: What's up guys Crypto Mix here back with another video And today we're going to talk about litecoin and where it would be headed in the future. Is it too late to invest or buy litecoins right now? let's find out So if you are new to altcoins, especially Litecoin, perhaps you don't know what Litecoin is or what is its purpose. So to just explain simply, Litecoin is a form of digital currency. You can pay for services or items that you want to buy. You can transfer money from person-to-person, even how far that person would be without going to banks or some transit transfer services. Also, the transactions are faster and cheaper than sending traditional fiat currencies from one place to another. So I think maybe, you are wondering Bitcoin does that too right? It's like the purpose of Bitcoin Yea, you're right The only difference is that Litecoin, transfer is cheaper and faster than bitcoin So nowadays a simple bitcoin transaction would cost you around like 15 to 25 bucks and the transfer time is I think it took 24 to 48 hours as of today because I think the um blockchain is very busy right now on Bitcoin exchanges so I think it kind of took 24 to 48 hours to reach the at the end of the transaction or before it confirms or before the miner confirms a transaction so that cost a lot of money and time on the process so in litecoin the cost of transaction I think when I check it it's just 30 cents per transaction and the speed is almost instant so this is because um the block size of litecoin is eight times bigger than the bitcoin so bigger block size means that that there are more transactions per block and it becomes faster to be confirmed so i can say that litecoin is an exact duplicate of bitcoin as a matter of fact um charlie lee who is a former google employee and the creator of litecoin forked it from the uh bitcoin core so even though many um have said that it is just a silver compared to Bitcoin, I think it offers many better features than the original bitcoins. so besides we know who the creator of litecoin is, as opposed to Satoshi Nakamoto that everyone doesn't know who so for me like trusting bitcoin is like giving a blind fake to the coin itself as we can see here in this chart like coin rise up so much that you know it came from uh like 60 50 60 dollars last month and today or yesterday is the highest point at about $348 so the big question is is it too late to buy litecoin I think um if you are a short-term trader as we can see litecoin is over bought as of today we can see here on the RSI chart that I think here it goes above the over overbought threshold so I think if you can see this kind of signal there will be i'm certain and maybe i am expecting and there is a big chance that there is a correction soon i don't know um i don't know how long will this rally will last but soon there will be a correction on the litecoin price so i think if you are a short-term trader wait for the correction and then you can get your um position, go in, and then I think light coin would be a good investment on 2018. So on the other hand, if you are a longterm trader. You won't even notice this kind of uptrend. maybe you can see it on the all time chart, but if you will but if you are holding litecoin for many years then I believe that litecoin will go up higher than this rally right now so if you still want to maximize your profit then you can found a perfect position to go inside after the correction happens, maybe I think this week or maybe next week. So as for me personally I intend to buy Litecoins in the future. So I am just waiting for a perfect position to go in. I will wait for the correction so I think it is better than bitcoin but the only thing why bitcoin is valued so high is because it is the first coin that is introduced back in the day litecoin was introduced like.. Late 2011 So, yeah. I think people think that bitcoin is the original cryptocurrency out there So yeah, That's why bitcoin is very high value So to summarize. If you want to buy some Litecoins. Or, Invite in litecoins. Wait for the correction i think it is happening very soon after the correction you can go in i think litecoin will still go up next year so i think that's it guys for today thank you so much for watching give it a thumbs up if you any questions, just post a comment down below. Don't forget to subscribe. Click the link on the lower right corner. I put a subscribe button there, so enable post notifications. There is a bell, a little bell icon so you won't miss any of my future videos. As always guys, see you on the next video.
